status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE; 142 EditMode and 43 PlayMode passed; Quest/PICO APKs built and audited; Quest 0.2.4/code 7 installed; Quest hand-following confirmed by user; other device acceptance pending
user_feedback: After New Game, the hand mesh stays frozen while rays and equipment still respond. This is a confirmed 0.2.3 visual regression, not a claim that tracking input has stopped.
root_cause: The production Meta prefab contains four manual-update distance-grab reticle HandVisual objects before two live HandVisual objects. The old first-valid-per-hand selection revealed preview hands and suppressed the live models. Disabling the independent pinch visual writer also left its skinned indicator visible.

pages.title: 0.2.4 Live Hand Visual Regression Fix
pages.intro: Historical 0.2.4 correction for GD-HAND-01, GD-HAND-02, GD-PAUSE-01 and IP-03. User confirmed normal hand following after New Game on Quest 3 0.2.4. The live-hand selection fix is retained; InteractionStages.json defines current 0.2.5 presentation and separate pending acceptance.

blocks.text: User device feedback confirmed that hand models froze after starting the game while rays and equipment continued responding. The production player prefab has six HandVisual instances: four distance-grab preview hands followed by two live player hands. Preview SyntheticHands update manually and can retain valid but old poses; they must never be selected as player hands. The live hands also use SyntheticHand, so filtering all synthetic sources would be incorrect.

items: Exclude ReticleGhostDrawer descendants from live-hand material binding and independently mask their renderers. Preserve their SDK-owned ForceOffVisibility and original materials.

Bind the two live HandVisual meshes, preserving SDK data sources, bone transforms and WhenHandUpdated subscriptions. Apply only an independent forceRenderingOff mask for focus/tracking availability; never overwrite SDK renderer.enabled or ForceOffVisibility.

Hide the independent RayInteractorPinchVisual skinned indicator as well as stopping its visual updater. Keep interactors active. Restore all saved renderer masks, materials and visual component states on disable.

blocks.text: Current Editor verification: 142 EditMode and 43 PlayMode passes, zero failures, in Logs/EmberdeepHandFreeze/Verification. Three new regressions use the production prefab and SDK HandVisual: two live/four preview separation, deterministic root/finger motion through SDK update events with visibility ownership retained, and independent pinch indicator masking/restoration. The scene-wiring tests cover both hands through camp and fireground. These are Editor/synthetic tests, not physical tracking acceptance.

Device check: enter New Game with each hand visible; translate and rotate the wrist, open and curl all fingers, hold equipment, pause/resume, briefly lose tracking, then return to camp and enter again. Both model and equipment must continue following; no frozen duplicate or automatic firing on recovery. Repeat seated/standing on Quest 3 and PICO 4. M2/M3 remain PROPOSED.

Device confirmation: after installing 0.2.4/code 7, the user answered that the hand models now follow normally after New Game on Quest 3. This closes the reported frozen-model symptom on that device. It does not establish all-button usability, physical collision/comfort, PICO compatibility or measured performance.

device_confirmation.scope: Normal hand-model following after New Game; no blanket acceptance of all interactions/devices/performance.

subsequent_revision: InteractionStages.json defines 0.2.5 last-pose continuity and contextual hand posing; this 0.2.4 record remains historical.
